scope.summary: Dedicated embedding model distinct from the chat model: a second local-model registration whose ModelCapabilities declares supports_embedding + embedding dimension as an MT-016 product extension, so LoomSearchV2 embeds via the embedding-capable model resolved from the shared registry rather than via the single chat model's profile().model_id.
scope.origin: Deferred from MT-014 AC-4b per the MT-014 pre-implementation adversarial review (task aa63db63808f7a7b3, finding F9): 'dedicated embedding model distinct from the chat model' is materially larger than MT-014's embedding-dimension degrade-not-error fix and is unsupported by the current single-model config + capability model. acceptance_criteria: ModelCapabilities exposes supports_embedding and embedding_dimension as an MT-016 product extension; registration rejects inconsistent states such as supports_embedding=false with a dimension or supports_embedding=true without a positive dimension.

A second local embedding model can be configured independently from HANDSHAKE_LOCAL_MODEL_PATH, loaded through the embedded local runtime, registered in the same shared ModelRegistry, marked ready, and exposed in ModelCatalog as distinct from the chat model.

ModelCatalog exposes machine-readable embedding capability fields and a helper that selects a ready embedding-capable local model matching LoomSearchV2's canonical 768-dimensional index; chat-only and wrong-dimension models are ignored.
LocalModelRuntimeLlmClient rejects embedding calls for registered models whose capabilities do not declare supports_embedding, so adding a UUIDv7 registration is not enough to fake embedding support.

LoomSearchV2 reindex and search resolve the embedding-capable model from the catalog instead of hard-coding llm.profile().model_id; embedding calls use the selected model's per-boot routing UUIDv7, while persisted/search `embedding_model` values use the stable embedding-space key derived from artifact sha256 + embedding dimension.
LoomSearchV2 vector scoring and facets compare only rows whose stored embedding_model matches the query embedding model, preventing cross-model embedding-space contamination.
When no matching dedicated embedding model is configured, LoomSearchV2 degrades to keyword/trigram without calling the chat model for embeddings, fabricating vectors, or hard-erroring.
Existing MT-014 dimension mismatch degrade-not-error behavior remains intact and surfaces the typed dim-mismatch reason.

Same-change UserManual page/tool/behavior coverage documents purpose, startup/config variables, routing workflow, expected inputs/outputs, FR/EventLedger evidence, HBR-INT-009 posture, common failures, and recovery.
Pre- and post-implementation adversarial review completed; implementer may move MT-016 only to READY_FOR_VALIDATION, never COMPLETED.
scope.risk_if_missed: LoomSearchV2 semantic search is permanently tied to the single chat model's embedding output; operators cannot run a separate, correctly-dimensioned embedding model, limiting semantic search quality and the CPU-baseline story.

findings_and_decisions: Capability gap: ModelCapabilities and current spec 4.6.3 do not list embedding support. DECISION: implement supports_embedding + embedding_dimension as an MT-016 product extension and avoid claiming existing spec support.

Single-model boot gap: LocalModelConfig and build_default_local_client are chat-model-only. DECISION: add a second HANDSHAKE_LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL_* config, load/register it into the same ModelRegistry, and keep profile().model_id on the chat model.

Loom routing gap: embed_text uses llm.profile().model_id. DECISION: resolve a ready catalog entry matching LOOM_SEARCH_EMBEDDING_DIM, use that model id for EmbeddingRequest routing, and use a stable embedding-space key (artifact sha256 + dimension) for durable embedding_model storage/search comparison.
Fake-green trap: LocalModelRuntimeLlmClient can embed any registered UUIDv7 model. DECISION: enforce declared supports_embedding before runtime.embed.

Storage contamination gap: loom_block_search_index.embedding_model is written but vector scoring does not filter by it. DECISION: add request embedding_model and filter vector scoring/facets to matching rows only.
Proof gap: existing pg_or_skip! tests can skip. DECISION: MT-016 managed-resource tests must fail if PostgreSQL is unavailable and must inspect embedding_model rows.
Manual/HBR gap: MT-014 has feature-only manual text. DECISION: add first-class dedicated-embedding UserManual page/tool/behavior coverage.
